This map inventories the source-backed documents prepared by the development
installers. `Source ID` is the stable AK5e installer identifier, not a Foundry
document ID. Preserve Foundry document IDs only when exporting verified release
packs, as described in the release checklist.

## Traceability rules

- Generated Items and Actors retain the source heading, source file, and raw
  source in `flags.ak5e`; journals retain the same fields on the Journal Entry.
- Chapter 6 action, reaction, legendary, lair, and mythic entries are embedded
  feature Items on their source Actor and remain traceable through the Actor's
  raw source and the feature section flag.
- The map must be regenerated after any approved source or generated-content
  change: `node ak5e/tools/build-content-map.mjs`.
